    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">OceanBase 日常运维命令 200 条</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>说明：以下命令默认在 <strong>sys 租户</strong>执行，系统视图均带 <code>oceanbase.</code> 前缀；在业务租户内可省略前缀。<code>:xxx</code> 为占位符，请替换为实际值。除特别标注外，语法以 <strong>OceanBase 4.x</strong> 为准，3.x 差异已在条目中注明。命令中标注「MySQL 租户 / Oracle 租户」的需在对应兼容模式租户内执行。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="一连接与基础环境112">一、连接与基础环境（1–12）</h2>
<ol>
<li><code>obclient -h&lt;OBProxy_IP&gt; -P2883 -uroot@sys -p -c -A oceanbase</code> —— 通过 OBProxy 连接 sys 租户</li>
<li><code>obclient -h&lt;OBProxy_IP&gt; -P2883 -u&lt;user&gt;@&lt;tenant&gt;#&lt;cluster&gt; -p -c -A</code> —— 通过 OBProxy 连接业务租户</li>
<li><code>obclient -h&lt;OBServer_IP&gt; -P2881 -uroot@sys -p -Doceanbase</code> —— 直连 OBServer</li>
<li><code>obd cluster list</code> —— 查看本机纳管集群列表</li>
<li><code>obd cluster display &lt;cluster_name&gt;</code> —— 查看集群各节点运行状态</li>
<li><code>obd cluster tenant show &lt;cluster_name&gt; -g</code> —— 查看集群内租户及资源</li>
<li><code>obd cluster edit-config &lt;cluster_name&gt;</code> —— 查看/编辑集群部署配置</li>
<li><code>obd cluster start &lt;cluster_name&gt;</code> —— 启动集群</li>
<li><code>obd cluster stop &lt;cluster_name&gt;</code> —— 停止集群</li>
<li><code>obd cluster restart &lt;cluster_name&gt;</code> —— 重启集群</li>
<li><code>SELECT BANNER FROM V$VERSION;</code> —— 查看版本（Oracle 租户）</li>
<li><code>SELECT VERSION();</code> —— 查看版本（MySQL 租户）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="二集群与节点巡检1332">二、集群与节点巡检（13–32）</h2>
<ol start="13">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_ZONES;</code> —— 查看 Zone 列表与状态</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_SERVERS;</code> —— 查看 OBServer 节点列表</li>
<li><code>SELECT SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,ZONE,WITH_ROLE,STATUS,START_SERVICE_TIME,STOP_TIME FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_SERVERS;</code> —— 节点角色与服务状态</li>
<li><code>SELECT SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,ZONE,CPU_CAPACITY,CPU_ASSIGNED,CPU_ASSIGNED_MAX,MEM_CAPACITY,MEM_ASSIGNED,MEM_LIMIT,DATA_DISK_CAPACITY,DATA_DISK_IN_USE,LOG_DISK_CAPACITY,LOG_DISK_IN_USE FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SERVERS;</code> —— 节点资源总量与分配</li>
<li><code>SELECT SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,HEARTBEAT_STATUS FROM oceanbase.__all_virtual_server_stat;</code> —— 节点心跳状态</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_ROOTSERVICE_EVENT_HISTORY ORDER BY TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— RootService 事件</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_SERVER_EVENT_HISTORY ORDER BY TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 节点事件</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_SERVER_JOBS;</code> —— 节点后台任务</li>
<li><code>SELECT SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,ROUND(DATA_DISK_IN_USE/DATA_DISK_CAPACITY*100,2) DATA_PCT,ROUND(LOG_DISK_IN_USE/LOG_DISK_CAPACITY*100,2) LOG_PCT FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SERVERS;</code> —— 数据盘/日志盘使用率</li>
<li><code>SELECT SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,CPU_CAPACITY,CPU_ASSIGNED,ROUND(CPU_ASSIGNED/CPU_CAPACITY*100,2) CPU_PCT FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SERVERS;</code> —— CPU 分配率</li>
<li><code>SELECT SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,MEM_CAPACITY,MEM_ASSIGNED,MEM_LIMIT,ROUND(MEM_ASSIGNED/MEM_CAPACITY*100,2) MEM_PCT FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SERVERS;</code> —— 内存分配率</li>
<li><code>SHOW PARAMETERS LIKE '%datafile%';</code> —— 数据文件相关参数</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PARAMETERS WHERE NAME IN ('datafile_size','datafile_next','datafile_maxsize');</code> —— 数据文件扩容配置</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_UNITS;</code> —— 资源单元列表</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_UNITS;</code> —— 各节点资源单元明细</li>
<li><code>SELECT UNIT_ID,TENANT_ID,SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,ZONE,STATUS,MAX_CPU,MIN_CPU,MAX_MEMORY,MIN_MEMORY FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_UNITS;</code> —— 资源单元规格</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TENANTS;</code> —— 租户列表</li>
<li><code>SELECT TENANT_ID,TENANT_NAME,TENANT_TYPE,COMPATIBILITY_MODE,STATUS,LOCALITY,PRIMARY_ZONE FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TENANTS;</code> —— 租户关键属性</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TABLEGROUPS;</code> —— 表组列表</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TABLEGROUP_TABLES;</code> —— 表组内表清单</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="三租户与资源3345">三、租户与资源（33–45）</h2>
<ol start="33">
<li><code>SELECT TENANT_ID,TENANT_NAME,STATUS,COMPATIBILITY_MODE FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TENANTS WHERE TENANT_TYPE='USER';</code> —— 业务租户状态</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_TENANT_MEMORY;</code> —— 租户内存汇总</li>
<li><code>SELECT TENANT_ID,SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,ROUND(SUM(HOLD)/1024/1024/1024,2) HOLD_GB,ROUND(SUM(USED)/1024/1024/1024,2) USED_GB FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_MEMORY GROUP BY TENANT_ID,SVR_IP,SVR_PORT;</code> —— 租户内存占用</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_MEMORY WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id ORDER BY USED DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 租户内存模块 Top20</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SQL_WORKAREA_MEMORY_INFO ORDER BY MAX_MEM_USED DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— SQL 工作区内存</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TENANT_JOBS ORDER BY START_TIME DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 租户级任务</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TENANT_EVENT_HISTORY ORDER BY TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 租户事件历史</li>
<li><code>ALTER RESOURCE UNIT &lt;unit_name&gt; MAX_CPU=4, MIN_CPU=2, MEMORY_SIZE='8G';</code> —— 调整资源单元规格</li>
<li><code>CREATE RESOURCE UNIT &lt;unit_name&gt; MAX_CPU=4, MIN_CPU=2, MEMORY_SIZE='8G', LOG_DISK_SIZE='10G';</code> —— 创建资源单元</li>
<li><code>CREATE RESOURCE POOL &lt;pool_name&gt; UNIT='&lt;unit_name&gt;', UNIT_NUM=1, ZONE_LIST=('zone1','zone2','zone3');</code> —— 创建资源池</li>
<li><code>CREATE TENANT &lt;tenant_name&gt; RESOURCE_POOL_LIST=('&lt;pool_name&gt;') SET ob_compatibility_mode='mysql';</code> —— 创建租户</li>
<li><code>ALTER TENANT &lt;tenant_name&gt; SET VARIABLES ob_tcp_invited_nodes='%';</code> —— 放开租户访问白名单</li>
<li><code>DROP TENANT &lt;tenant_name&gt;;</code> —— 删除租户（需先确认无业务）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="四副本日志流与-paxos4662">四、副本、日志流与 Paxos（46–62）</h2>
<ol start="46">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_LS;</code> —— 日志流列表</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_LS WHERE STATUS&lt;&gt;'NORMAL';</code> —— 异常日志流</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_LS_LOCATIONS;</code> —— 日志流副本分布</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.CDB_OB_LS_LOCATIONS;</code> —— 全租户副本分布</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_LS_LOCATIONS WHERE LS_ID=:ls_id;</code> —— 指定日志流副本</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_LOG_STAT WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id;</code> —— 日志同步统计</li>
<li><code>SELECT TENANT_ID,LS_ID,SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,ROLE,IN_SYNC,PAXOS_REPLICA_NUM,END_SCN,MAX_SCN FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_LOG_STAT WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id ORDER BY LS_ID;</code> —— 副本角色与位点</li>
<li><code>SELECT TENANT_ID,LS_ID,SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,ROLE,IN_SYNC FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_LOG_STAT WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id AND IN_SYNC&lt;&gt;'YES';</code> —— 未同步副本</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_LS_REPLICA_TASKS;</code> —— 副本任务（迁移/重建）</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_LS_REPLICA_TASK_HISTORY ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 副本任务历史</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TABLE_LOCATIONS WHERE TABLE_NAME=:table_name;</code> —— 表/分区副本位置</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TABLE_LOCATIONS WHERE TABLE_ID=:table_id;</code> —— 按 Table ID 查副本</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SWITCH REPLICA LEADER LS=:ls_id SERVER='&lt;ip&gt;:&lt;port&gt;';</code> —— 切换日志流 Leader</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SWITCH REPLICA LEADER TENANT=&lt;tenant_name&gt; LS=:ls_id SERVER='&lt;ip&gt;:&lt;port&gt;';</code> —— 指定租户切主</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM ADD REPLICA LS=:ls_id SERVER='&lt;ip&gt;:&lt;port&gt;' PAXOS_REPLICA_NUM=3;</code> —— 增加副本</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM REMOVE REPLICA LS=:ls_id SERVER='&lt;ip&gt;:&lt;port&gt;';</code> —— 删除副本</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM CANCEL MIGRATE UNIT &lt;unit_id&gt;;</code> —— 取消资源单元迁移</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="五合并与转储6378">五、合并与转储（63–78）</h2>
<ol start="63">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_FREEZE_INFO ORDER BY FROZEN_SCN DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 冻结（转储）信息</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_MEMSTORE;</code> —— MemStore 内存占用</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_MEMSTORE_INFO;</code> —— MemStore 明细</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_MAJOR_COMPACTION;</code> —— 合并进度</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_COMPACTION_PROGRESS;</code> —— 合并进度明细</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_COMPACTION_DIAGNOSE_INFO;</code> —— 合并诊断信息</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_COMPACTION_SUGGESTIONS;</code> —— 合并建议</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_TABLET_COMPACTION_HISTORY ORDER BY START_TIME DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— Tablet 合并历史</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SSTABLES ORDER BY SIZE DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— SSTable 大小 Top20</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM MAJOR FREEZE;</code> —— 触发集群合并</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM MINOR FREEZE;</code> —— 触发转储</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM MAJOR FREEZE TENANT=&lt;tenant_name&gt;;</code> —— 指定租户合并</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET major_freeze_duty_time='02:00';</code> —— 设置每日合并时间</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET enable_major_freeze='True';</code> —— 开启自动合并</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_MAJOR_COMPACTION WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id;</code> —— 指定租户合并状态</li>
<li><code>SHOW PARAMETERS LIKE '%merge%';</code> —— 合并相关参数</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="六内存与缓存7992">六、内存与缓存（79–92）</h2>
<ol start="79">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_MEMORY ORDER BY USED DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 内存模块占用 Top20</li>
<li><code>SELECT TENANT_ID,CTX_NAME,MOD_NAME,ROUND(HOLD/1024/1024/1024,2) HOLD_GB,ROUND(USED/1024/1024/1024,2) USED_GB FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_MEMORY ORDER BY USED DESC LIMIT 30;</code> —— 内存模块明细</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_KVCACHE;</code> —— KVCache 使用情况</li>
<li><code>SELECT SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,CACHE_NAME,ROUND(CACHE_SIZE/1024/1024/1024,2) CACHE_GB,HIT_RATIO FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_KVCACHE;</code> —— 各缓存命中率</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_TENANT_MEMORY;</code> —— 租户内存上限与使用</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SQL_WORKAREA_MEMORY_INFO WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id;</code> —— 租户工作区内存</li>
<li><code>SHOW PARAMETERS LIKE 'memory_limit%';</code> —— 内存上限参数</li>
<li><code>SHOW PARAMETERS LIKE '%memstore%';</code> —— MemStore 相关参数</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET memory_limit='64G';</code> —— 调整节点内存上限</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET system_memory='8G';</code> —— 调整系统预留内存</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET memstore_limit_percentage=50;</code> —— MemStore 占比上限</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET freeze_trigger_percentage=30;</code> —— 冻结触发阈值</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_MEMSTORE WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id;</code> —— 租户 MemStore 使用</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET writing_throttling_trigger_percentage=80;</code> —— 写入限流阈值</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="七会话与连接93104">七、会话与连接（93–104）</h2>
<ol start="93">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PROCESSLIST LIMIT 50;</code> —— 当前会话列表</li>
<li><code>SELECT ID,USER,HOST,DB,TENANT,COMMAND,TIME,STATE,SQL_ID FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PROCESSLIST WHERE COMMAND&lt;&gt;'Sleep' ORDER BY TIME DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 活跃会话</li>
<li><code>SELECT TENANT,COUNT(*) SESSION_CNT FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PROCESSLIST GROUP BY TENANT;</code> —— 各租户连接数</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SESSION LIMIT 50;</code> —— 会话统计信息</li>
<li><code>SELECT SVR_IP,SVR_PORT,COUNT(*) FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PROCESSLIST GROUP BY SVR_IP,SVR_PORT;</code> —— 各节点连接数</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PS_STAT;</code> —— Prepared Statement 统计</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION '&lt;svr_ip&gt;:&lt;svr_port&gt;:&lt;session_id&gt;';</code> —— 终止会话（OceanBase 通用）</li>
<li><code>KILL &lt;session_id&gt;;</code> —— 终止会话（MySQL 租户）</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PROCESSLIST WHERE TIME&gt;600 ORDER BY TIME DESC;</code> —— 长会话排查</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PROCESSLIST WHERE USER=:user_name;</code> —— 指定用户会话</li>
<li><code>SHOW PROCESSLIST;</code> —— 查看会话（MySQL 租户）</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PROCESSLIST WHERE STATE LIKE '%wait%';</code> —— 等待中的会话</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="八锁与事务105114">八、锁与事务（105–114）</h2>
<ol start="105">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_LOCKS;</code> —— 当前锁信息</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_LOCKS WHERE BLOCK=1;</code> —— 阻塞中的锁</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_TRANSACTION_PARTICIPANTS;</code> —— 活跃事务参与者</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_TRANSACTION_PARTICIPANTS WHERE STATE&lt;&gt;'ACTIVE';</code> —— 非活跃事务</li>
<li><code>SELECT TRANS_ID,COUNT(*) FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_TRANSACTION_PARTICIPANTS GROUP BY TRANS_ID;</code> —— 事务参与者数量</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_LOCKS WHERE SESSION_ID=:session_id;</code> —— 指定会话持有的锁</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_TRANSACTION_PARTICIPANTS WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id AND SESSION_ID=:session_id;</code> —— 指定会话事务</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_TRANSACTION_PARTICIPANTS WHERE CTX_CREATE_TIME&lt;DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 10 MINUTE);</code> —— 长事务排查</li>
<li><code>SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'ob_trx_timeout';</code> —— 事务超时参数</li>
<li><code>SET GLOBAL ob_trx_timeout=100000000;</code> —— 调整事务超时（微秒）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="九sql-性能与执行计划115136">九、SQL 性能与执行计划（115–136）</h2>
<ol start="115">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SQL_AUDIT ORDER BY ELAPSED_TIME DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 最慢 SQL 明细</li>
<li><code>SELECT SQL_ID,COUNT(*) EXEC_CNT,ROUND(AVG(ELAPSED_TIME)/1000,2) AVG_MS,ROUND(MAX(ELAPSED_TIME)/1000,2) MAX_MS FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SQL_AUDIT WHERE REQUEST_TIME&gt;DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 1 HOUR) GROUP BY SQL_ID ORDER BY AVG_MS DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 近 1 小时慢 SQL 聚合</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SQL_AUDIT WHERE SQL_ID=:sql_id ORDER BY ELAPSED_TIME DESC LIMIT 10;</code> —— 指定 SQL 的执行记录</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PLAN_CACHE_PLAN_STAT ORDER BY EXECUTIONS DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 计划缓存统计</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PLAN_CACHE_PLAN_STAT WHERE SQL_ID=:sql_id;</code> —— 指定 SQL 的计划缓存</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PLAN_CACHE_PLAN_EXPLAIN WHERE PLAN_ID=:plan_id AND SVR_IP=:svr_ip AND SVR_PORT=:svr_port;</code> —— 缓存计划执行树</li>
<li><code>EXPLAIN SELECT ...;</code> —— 查看执行计划</li>
<li><code>EXPLAIN EXTENDED SELECT ...;</code> —— 扩展执行计划（MySQL 租户）</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SQL_PLAN WHERE SQL_ID=:sql_id;</code> —— 历史执行计划</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_SQL_PLAN_BASELINES;</code> —— SPM 计划基线</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_SQL_PLAN_BASELINES WHERE SQL_ID=:sql_id;</code> —— 指定 SQL 的基线</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_OUTLINES;</code> —— Outline 规则</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_OUTLINE_CONCURRENT_HISTORY ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— Outline 变更历史</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_CONCURRENT_LIMIT_SQL;</code> —— SQL 并发限流规则</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM FLUSH PLAN CACHE;</code> —— 清空计划缓存</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM FLUSH PLAN CACHE TENANT=&lt;tenant_name&gt;;</code> —— 清空指定租户计划缓存</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM FLUSH SQL AUDIT;</code> —— 清空 SQL 审计缓存</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET enable_sql_audit='True';</code> —— 开启 SQL 审计</li>
<li><code>SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'ob_query_timeout';</code> —— 查询超时参数</li>
<li><code>SET GLOBAL ob_query_timeout=10000000;</code> —— 调整查询超时（微秒）</li>
<li><code>SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'ob_sql_work_area_percentage';</code> —— SQL 工作区占比</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY WHERE SAMPLE_TIME&gt;DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) LIMIT 100;</code> —— 近 10 分钟 ASH 样本</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="十等待事件与诊断137146">十、等待事件与诊断（137–146）</h2>
<ol start="137">
<li><code>SELECT EVENT,COUNT(*) CNT FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY WHERE SAMPLE_TIME&gt;DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) GROUP BY EVENT ORDER BY CNT DESC;</code> —— 等待事件分布</li>
<li><code>SELECT SESSION_ID,EVENT,WAIT_CLASS,COUNT(*) CNT FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY GROUP BY SESSION_ID,EVENT,WAIT_CLASS ORDER BY CNT DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 会话级等待 Top20</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY WHERE SESSION_ID=:session_id;</code> —— 指定会话等待样本</li>
<li><code>SELECT SQL_ID,EVENT,COUNT(*) CNT FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_ACTIVE_SESSION_HISTORY WHERE SQL_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SQL_ID,EVENT ORDER BY CNT DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— SQL 级等待 Top20</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SQL_AUDIT WHERE TOTAL_WAITS&gt;0 ORDER BY TOTAL_WAIT_TIME_MICRO DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 累计等待最多的 SQL</li>
<li><code>SELECT last_trace_id();</code> —— 获取当前会话 Trace ID</li>
<li><code>SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'ob_enable_trace_log';</code> —— 查看 Trace 开关</li>
<li><code>SET ob_enable_trace_log=1;</code> —— 开启会话 Trace</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_SQL_AUDIT WHERE TRACE_ID=:trace_id;</code> —— 按 Trace ID 追踪 SQL</li>
<li><code>SHOW WARNINGS;</code> —— 查看最近告警信息</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="十一表分区与统计信息147158">十一、表、分区与统计信息（147–158）</h2>
<ol start="147">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TABLE_LOCATIONS WHERE TENANT_ID=:tenant_id LIMIT 50;</code> —— 表分布概览</li>
<li><code>SELECT TABLE_NAME,PARTITION_NAME,ROLE,ZONE,SVR_IP,SVR_PORT FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TABLE_LOCATIONS WHERE TABLE_NAME=:table_name;</code> —— 指定表分区副本</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TABLEGROUPS;</code> —— 表组信息</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TABLEGROUP_TABLES WHERE TABLEGROUP_NAME=:tg_name;</code> —— 表组成员</li>
<li><code>SHOW TABLES;</code> —— 查看当前库表</li>
<li><code>SHOW CREATE TABLE &lt;table_name&gt;;</code> —— 查看建表语句</li>
<li><code>SHOW TABLE STATUS LIKE '&lt;table_name&gt;';</code> —— 表状态（MySQL 租户）</li>
<li><code>SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,TABLE_ROWS,DATA_LENGTH,INDEX_LENGTH FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=:schema_name ORDER BY DATA_LENGTH DESC LIMIT 20;</code> —— 表容量 Top20</li>
<li><code>ANALYZE TABLE &lt;table_name&gt;;</code> —— 收集统计信息（MySQL 租户）</li>
<li><code>SHOW INDEX FROM &lt;table_name&gt;;</code> —— 查看索引</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=:schema_name AND TABLE_NAME=:table_name;</code> —— 索引明细</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=:schema_name AND TABLE_NAME=:table_name;</code> —— 分区明细</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="十二参数管理159166">十二、参数管理（159–166）</h2>
<ol start="159">
<li><code>SHOW PARAMETERS;</code> —— 查看集群参数</li>
<li><code>SHOW PARAMETERS LIKE '%timeout%';</code> —— 按名称过滤参数</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.GV$OB_PARAMETERS WHERE NAME=:param_name;</code> —— 指定参数在各节点取值</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.V$OB_PARAMETERS WHERE NAME=:param_name;</code> —— 当前节点参数取值</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET &lt;param_name&gt;=&lt;value&gt;;</code> —— 修改集群级参数</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET &lt;param_name&gt;=&lt;value&gt; TENANT=&lt;tenant_name&gt;;</code> —— 修改租户级参数</li>
<li><code>SHOW VARIABLES LIKE '%';</code> —— 查看会话变量</li>
<li><code>SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'ob_%';</code> —— 查看 OceanBase 扩展变量</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="十三备份与恢复167187">十三、备份与恢复（167–187）</h2>
<ol start="167">
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET backup_dest='oss://&lt;bucket&gt;/&lt;path&gt;';</code> —— 配置 OSS 备份路径</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET backup_dest='file:///obbackup';</code> —— 配置本地/NFS 备份路径</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET backup_concurrency=4;</code> —— 设置备份并发度</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET backup_region='&lt;region&gt;';</code> —— 设置备份区域</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_BACKUP_PARAMETER;</code> —— 备份参数</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_BACKUP_STORAGE_INFO;</code> —— 备份存储信息</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM BACKUP DATABASE;</code> —— 发起集群级全量备份</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM BACKUP TENANT &lt;tenant_name&gt;;</code> —— 发起租户级备份</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM BACKUP INCREMENTAL DATABASE;</code> —— 发起增量备份（3.x；4.x 增量随全量自动进行）</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_BACKUP_JOBS ORDER BY JOB_ID DESC;</code> —— 备份作业</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_BACKUP_TASKS ORDER BY JOB_ID DESC;</code> —— 备份子任务</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_BACKUP_SET_FILES ORDER BY BACKUP_SET_ID DESC;</code> —— 备份集文件</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.CDB_OB_BACKUP_SET_FILES ORDER BY BACKUP_SET_ID DESC;</code> —— 全租户备份集</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_BACKUP_JOB_HISTORY ORDER BY JOB_ID DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 备份作业历史</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_BACKUP_TASK_HISTORY ORDER BY JOB_ID DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 备份任务历史</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM CANCEL BACKUP;</code> —— 取消集群备份</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM CANCEL BACKUP TENANT &lt;tenant_name&gt;;</code> —— 取消租户备份</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_BACKUP_DELETE_POLICY;</code> —— 备份清理策略</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET backup_recovery_window='7d';</code> —— 设置备份可恢复窗口</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.CDB_OB_BACKUP_DELETE_POLICY;</code> —— 全租户清理策略</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM RESTORE &lt;dest_tenant&gt; FROM &lt;source_tenant&gt; AT 'file:///obbackup/&lt;path&gt;' UNTIL '&lt;timestamp&gt;' WITH 'backup_set_id=&lt;id&gt;';</code> —— 发起租户恢复</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="十四归档188194">十四、归档（188–194）</h2>
<ol start="188">
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM SET log_archive_dest='file:///obarchive';</code> —— 配置归档路径</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM ARCHIVELOG;</code> —— 开启归档模式</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM NOARCHIVELOG;</code> —— 关闭归档模式</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_ARCHIVELOG;</code> —— 归档进度</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_ARCHIVE_DEST;</code> —— 归档目标状态</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_ARCHIVELOG_PIECE_FILES;</code> —— 归档 Piece 明细</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_ARCHIVELOG_SUMMARY;</code> —— 归档汇总</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="十五事件日志与告警195200">十五、事件日志与告警（195–200）</h2>
<ol start="195">
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_ROOTSERVICE_EVENT_HISTORY WHERE EVENT LIKE '%error%' ORDER BY TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— RootService 异常事件</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_SERVER_EVENT_HISTORY WHERE EVENT LIKE '%error%' ORDER BY TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 节点异常事件</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_TENANT_EVENT_HISTORY WHERE EVENT LIKE '%error%' ORDER BY TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 租户异常事件</li>
<li><code>ob_admin log_tool --help</code> —— 查看日志解析工具用法</li>
<li><code>grep -E 'ERROR|WARN' observer.log | tail -100</code> —— 查看 OBServer 错误日志</li>
<li><code>SELECT * FROM oceanbase.DBA_OB_LS_REPLICA_TASK_HISTORY WHERE TASK_STATUS&lt;&gt;'SUCCESS' ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT 50;</code> —— 失败副本任务排查</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<p><strong>使用提示</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>备份恢复、归档相关命令需先配置 <code>backup_dest</code> / <code>log_archive_dest</code> 并确认存储可写；恢复命令还需目标集群资源与租户名规划。</li>
<li><code>ALTER SYSTEM ...</code> 类命令影响面较大，建议在变更窗口执行并提前备份参数原值（<code>SHOW PARAMETERS</code>）。</li>
<li>3.x 与 4.x 在日志流（LS）、租户资源、增量备份机制上存在差异，执行前请以目标版本官方文档为准。</li>
<li>所有涉及占位符的命令，请替换为实际 IP、端口、租户名、表名后再执行。</li>
</ul>


</div>
